rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when materials or items are being recycled without stressing the processing or the act of carrying them out.

example.english: We can recycle these plastic bottles.
example.traditional: 我哋可以回收呢啲膠樽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 wui4 sau1 ni1 di1 gaau1 zeon1

rows.note: Use this when specifically referring to processing waste into new usable material, especially in environmental or formal wording.

example.english: Factories recycle this waste plastic into new products.
example.traditional: 工廠會將呢啲廢膠循環再造，整成新產品。
example.jyutping: gung1 cong2 wui5 zoeng1 ni1 di1 fai3 gaau1 ceon4 waan4 zoi3 zou6 zing2 sing4 san1 caan2 ban2

rows.note: Use this when you mean throwing an item directly into a recycling bin.

example.english: You need to recycle the plastic bottle by throwing it into the recycling bin.
example.traditional: 你要將個膠樽掉入回收箱先得。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 zoeng1 go3 gaau1 zeon1 diu6 jap6 wui4 sau1 soeng1 sin1 dak1

rows.note: Use this when someone takes items out or sets them aside to be collected for recycling.

example.english: I'll take the old newspapers to recycle later.
example.traditional: 我一陣拎去回收啲舊報紙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zan6 ling1 heoi3 wui4 sau1 di1 gau6 bou3 zi2
